we have identified a novel genetic variant that is associated with the risk of schizophrenia and that is present at a higher frequency in the 22Q11 deletion syndrome (22Q11DS).

the identification of genes that contribute to the risk of schizophrenia and other psychiatric disorders.
the genetic and environmental factors that contribute to the development of psychiatric disorders.
the genetic and neurobiological basis of psychiatric disorders.
